tools.name: Built-in browser on the PC
tools.does: Scrolls the reels grid, reads views, covers, captions and counters, pulls still frames
tools.detail: Used today on 1 page: 28 reels listed, 25 covers, 9 reels read, 2 with stills.

tools.name: Sound measuring in the page
tools.does: Loudness, pitch and spectrum of a reel's audio, measured inside the browser
tools.detail: Existing skill. Not run on any reel of this page yet.

tools.name: yt-dlp (command line)
tools.does: Fetches a reel to a temporary file on the PC so the tools below can read it
tools.detail: Needs the command-line script to be run on the PC. Not run yet.

tools.name: faster-whisper (command line)
tools.does: Turns the spoken words into a timed transcript
tools.detail: Not run yet. No reel on this page has a transcript.

tools.name: ffmpeg audio stats (command line)
tools.does: Loudness and silence map of the soundtrack
